release_notes:
New to Snippets? A short guided tour now greets you on first launch: a spotlight walks you through + New snippet, each field in the editor and Save

Short on ideas? Fill in an example sets up a ready-to-save \_hello greeting in one click

The last step opens Notepad so you can try your new trigger, and the tour lets you know when it expands

Replay the tour anytime from Snippets › Take the tour, or press Escape to leave it. If you already have snippets, it never starts on its own
